Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. PERFORMANCE BANK GUARANTEE (PBG) The successful tenderer/contractor shall furnish a Performance Bank Guarantee in the prescribed format as per Annexure-F. The value of Performance Bank Guarantee shall be 10% of the Contract Value excluding Packing, F orwarding, Transportation and Insurance charges. The Performance Bank Guarantee shall remain valid for satisf actory performance of the repaired Generator Transformer, warranty period of 12 months from the date of repai r completion/testing/ commissioning, and shall continue to remain valid until settlement of all claims of BBMB a gainst the contractor, if any. Failure to furnish the Performance Bank Guarantee within the prescribed period sh all be treated as breach of contract. 2. Integrity Pact i) BBMB has adopted the Integrity Pact program as per guidelines of CVC, Govt. of India to promote integrity , transparency and competitiveness in BBMB’s procurement of works/services/equipment etc. To implement the said Integrity Pact concept, BBMB has appointed a panel of two IEMs (Independent External Monitors). T he name, address & contact details of IEMs are as under: - Shri Bimal Julka, Sh. Shyam Nandan Prasad, IAS (Retd.), (Former Director, Coal India Ltd.), st Address-58, Anand Lok, 1 Floor, Address- Flat No. 704, New Delhi-110049, Tower No. 7, Beverly Apartments, Sector-22, Dwarka, new Delhi-110007 Email: - bimaljulka1955@gmail.com Email: - shyamnandanprasad@yahoo.com. (M) 9818000365 (M) 9073330538 ii) For the implementation of Integrity Pact an agreement between the Principal (BBMB, the purchaser) and te nderer/bidder/contractor/supplier is necessary in case of procurement of works/services/goods/equipments irrespective of whether it is from Foreign/Indian tenderer/ bidder/contractor/supplier. iii) The soft copy of agreement along with relevant Appendices has been uploaded with the tender documents. The tenderer/bidder/contractor/suppliers are required to submit the said agreement on Non-Judicial Stamp paper of value Rs. 15/- (duly attested by the competent attesting authority to make it a legal document) alo ng with EMD. In prescribed Proforma attached as Annexure-C and tender. Tenders not accompanied by the said Agreement on behalf of tenderer shall not be considered. In case of any complaint regarding tende ring, the tenderer/bidder/contractor/supplier may contact both or any one of the IEMs. This is the necessary pre-qualifying requirement to participate in the tendering process. Following may also be noted. a) If the tenderer/bidder/contractor/supplier has been disqualified from the tender process prior to the a ward of contract according to the provision under Integrity Pact, BBMB shall be entitled to demand and recover from tenderer/bidder/contractor/supplier liquidated damages amount by forfeiting the EMD/Bid security (Bid Bond) as per provisions of Integrity Pact. b) If the contract has been terminated according to the provisions of the Integrity Pact, or if BBMB is ent itled to terminate the contract according to provisions of Integrity Pact, BBMB shall be entitled to dema nd and recover from the Tenderer/bidder/contractor/supplier/ Security Deposit as per Integrity Pact. iv) The applicant should confirm their acceptance to the above provisions in their request. 3. Sr.Xen /Addl. S.E., O&M, Ganguwal & Kotla Power Houses or any other officer authorized by Superintending E ngineer, Canal Power Houses Circle, BBMB, Nangal shall be Site-In-Charge of work from BBMB side. 4. The Site-In-Charge of tenderer/bidder/contractor/supplier shall not be less than Graduate Engineer with not les s than 7 years experience in Generator Transformers (Affidavit from tenderer/bidder/contractor/supplier in the n

ame of aforesaid engineer shall be taken before commencement of work at site. The contractor shall not deploy any person below the age of 18 years. The Workmen/Supervisors to be engaged shall be exclusively on contract basis and they shall have no right in any way for direct or indirect employment in BBMB. During the currency of contract and after its expiry or termination, no employee of the contractor who ever worked on contract against this work will be offered direct or indirect employment of BBMB. Sufficient Nos. of experience holder sub-tender er/bidder/ contractor/supplier personnels should be deputed and should be certified having sufficient experienc e to handle such type of work in the Generator Transformers. No deviation on this account shall be allowed. 3. PRE-QUALIFICATION CRITERIA The bidder shall up-load the requisite documents to establish the qualifying requirements on GeM porta. lThe tende r documents of only those applicants shall be evaluated further, who fulfil the following qualifying requirements. Th e Pre-qualification criteria is as below: - 1. The bidder shall be either a manufacturer of Generator Transformers; or an authorized Indian dealer/ rep resentative of such manufacturer; or a firm having experience in repair of Generator Transformers of ratin g 34 MVA, 11/132 kV or higher, either independently under work orders issued directly by a Power Gen erating Utility in its own name or on behalf of a manufacturer under work orders issued by such manufact urer. The partial WOs of, Repair of faulty Generators Transformers of rating 34 MVA, 11/132KV or rating mo re than above (MVA/Voltage) and AMC (Annual Maintenance Contracts) shall not be considered. In support the bidder shall submit the following documents: - The Bidder should have successfully executed similar jobs/ similar supplies at least three Purchase Orders/ Work Orders each having minimum value of ₹ 96 Lakh during last 07 years ending 31.03.2026. The copies of Purchase Orders/ Work Orders be supplied. OR The Bidder should have successfully executed similar jobs/ similar supplies at least two Purchase Orders/ Work Orders each having minimum value of ₹ 120 Lakh during last 07 years ending 31.03.2026. The copie s of Purchase Orders/ Work Orders be supplied. OR The Bidder should have successfully executed similar jobs/ similar supplies at least one Purchase Order/ W ork Order each having minimum value of ₹ 192 Lakh during last 07 years ending 31.03.2026. The copies o f Purchase Orders/ Work Orders be supplied. Note:- For the purpose of this eligibility criterion, Similar jobs/works shall mean successfully completed re pair work of Generator Transformers having a rating of 34 MVA or higher; and Similar supplies shall mean s upplies against complete Purchase Orders successfully executed for Transformers having a rating of 34 MV A or higher, covering Supply, Erection, Testing and Commissioning. 2. The bidder shall furnish at least one satisfactory performance certificate issued by an end-user (Govern ment Department/State Electricity Board/PSU/Power Utility) for repair of a Generator Transformer of rating 34 MVA, 11/132 kV or above. The copy of the concerned WO, whose satisfactory completion / performance certificate has been supplied, be accompanied. 3. The bidder shall submit documentary evidence of availability of repair/manufacturing facilities including EOT crane, Vapour Phase Drying (VPD) system, winding machine, etc., and in-house NABL-accredited testing facilities capable of carrying out all routine, type and special tests as per IS 2026. 4. The bidder shall have an Average Annual Financial Turnover of not less than ₹72 lakhs during the last th ree financial years ending 31.03.2026. Audited financial statements or a certificate from a Chartered Acco untant shall be submitted in support. 5. The bidder shall submit a notarized affidavit stating that it has not been blacklisted, banned or debarred by any Government Department, PSU or other organization in India. 6. The bidder shall submit a self-certified declaration that it has not been convicted by any Court of Law or debarred by any Government Department/PSU for offences relating to fraud, corruption or contractual mis

conduct. 7. The bidder shall furnish an undertaking confirming that the duly signed Integrity Pact, as prescribed in th e tender specification at Annexure- C, has been submitted along with the bid. 8. The applicant should furnish an undertaking in the prescribed format provided in the NIT for participating in the e-reverse auction. 9. Each bidder must also produce with their bid the Self attested copy of a. PAN Registration, b. GST Registration, 10. The bidder must visit and inspect the site at their risk and cost so as to apprise himself of Scope of Work. Ig norance shown at a later stage about the system shall not be entertained. For visiting the site, bidder shou ld contact the Sr. Xen/ASE, (O&M), Ganguwal and Kotla Power House. 11. The documents submitted by the vendors are subject to scrutiny by the purchases and their bids are liabl e to be rejected at any stage for non-compliance of NIT terms and conditions even if tender documents ha d been issued to such vendors. 12. Issue of tender documents shall not automatically construe qualification of tenderer for award of contract, which shall be determined during bid evaluation. 13. The firm should upload all the requisite documents complete in all respects but if required/needed, clarific ations regarding shortcoming/ deficiency in documents related to Technical and Commercial Bid can be as ked during the evaluation process. .
